name: Hive 1.19.0
notes: Features: repos from the phone (list, clone, switch, pull, open a PR) with fork-aware pull requests opened upstream as drafts; whole-file proposal view so the phone renders Markdown changes; Kubernetes deployment design and a container image for the hive binary. Bridge to Ligus: LIGUS_* environment variables, .ligus/ and ligus.config.toml are read alongside the Hive names, ligus:// links are accepted, and the updater checks both the new and the original GitHub address. Hive is becoming Ligus, short for ligustica, in 2.0.
